visual: Dwarf clump-forming saxifrage with scalloped dark green foliage showing pinkish-red tones and variegation, topped in autumn by masses of bright pink star-shaped flowers with contrasting yellow centres.
water: Keep consistently moist during active growth, but ensure excess water drains freely.
soilWarning: Shelter it; no drought or winter wet
prune: No routine pruning required; remove spent flower stems and damaged foliage when necessary.
resilience: Hardy through most of the UK when grown in a sheltered, moisture-retentive but well-drained position.
uses: Shady borders, woodland gardens, rock gardens, containers, courtyard planting and autumn colour.
